families.title: Argument framework structure
families.hypothesis: Validate finite argument and attack records without interpreting any real claim.

families.title: Conflict-free candidate check
families.hypothesis: Identify internal attacks in a declared candidate set.

families.title: Direct attacker inventory
families.hypothesis: Return the finite direct attackers of one declared argument.

families.title: Defended-argument characteristic step
families.hypothesis: Compute which arguments a finite candidate set defends.

families.title: Admissible extension check
families.hypothesis: Check conflict freedom and defense for every selected argument.

families.title: Argument range projection
families.hypothesis: Return a candidate set and every argument it attacks as a finite range.

families.title: Complete extension fixed-point check
families.hypothesis: Check whether a candidate is admissible and contains exactly what it defends.

families.title: Grounded extension construction
families.hypothesis: Construct the least characteristic-function fixed point on a finite framework.

families.title: Preferred extension enumeration
families.hypothesis: Enumerate inclusion-maximal admissible sets for a finite framework.

families.title: Stable extension enumeration
families.hypothesis: Enumerate conflict-free sets that attack every outside argument.

families.title: Naive extension enumeration
families.hypothesis: Enumerate maximal conflict-free sets without upgrading them to other semantics.

families.title: Skeptical acceptance projection
families.hypothesis: Check whether an argument appears in every extension under one declared semantics.

families.title: Credulous acceptance projection
families.hypothesis: Check whether an argument appears in at least one extension under one declared semantics.

families.title: Semantics comparison matrix
families.hypothesis: Compare finite extension families without treating a semantic convention as truth about the world.

families.title: Shortest attack-path counterexample
families.hypothesis: Return one deterministic shortest attack path when a declared path exists.

families.title: Strong attack-component decomposition
families.hypothesis: Partition the finite attack graph into strongly connected components.

families.title: Accessible extension summary
families.hypothesis: Represent extension rows with literal text while reserving human accessibility evaluation.

families.title: Argument handover provenance projection
families.hypothesis: Represent a fixity-bound synthetic handover with explicit unresolved holds.

families.title: Real deliberation evidence vacancy
families.hypothesis: Expose absent participants, real deliberation records and independent review as an open gap.

families.title: Decision authority reservation
families.hypothesis: Hold publication, adjudication, identity, legal, cultural and Maori-authority actions behind exact authority.
